title: Radial-Angular MEG Representational Geometry: Reproducibility Code and Archived Results
description: Code, frozen protocol snapshots, compact numerical outputs, numerical self-tests, and figure-generation material supporting the manuscript 'Reproducible Radial-Angular Geometry of Visual Category Representations in Human MEG: Phase Organization Beyond Amplitude Structure'. Source COGITATE neuroimaging data are not redistributed and remain available from the original public repositories.
